subject: Cross-border MAP — EU residency evaluation & hosting-route selection
messages:
From: Anna Müller <anna@veridian-health.de>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Blake <thomas@veridian-health.de>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Veridian MAP kickoff & residency constraints

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the intro call this morning. As discussed, Veridian needs a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that makes clear the evaluation milestones and a binding decision date for hosting (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Two hard constraints from our side:

- All production data for EU patients must remain in the EU (ideally DE datacenter).
- We require SOC 2 + audit logs retention of 7 years and proof of KMS/HSM support or BYOK options.

Our procurement deadline is the week of Mar 8–12 and execs want a recommendation before then. Can you draft a MAP with milestones for a 3-week eval (POC) and a proposed close timeline? I attached our RFP and vendor questionnaire to save time.

Anna
Director of Data & Privacy
Veridian Health

Attachment: Veridian_RFP.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna@veridian-health.de>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Thomas Blake <thomas@veridian-health.de>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Veridian MAP kickoff & residency constraints

Anna —

Appreciate the clear constraints. Drafting a concise MAP now and proposing an evaluation plan that lets you run guarded checks across our three serving modes so you can make an informed tradeoff. High-level suggestion:

1) Week 1 (POC onboarding): Hosted (EU region) trial with a scoped workload (subset of API routes, synthetic traffic) to validate latency, prefixes, and streaming behavior.
2) Week 2 (throughput & SLA sim): Dedicated reserved capacity for running your sustained load pattern and validation of autoscaling/burst characteristics.
3) Week 3 (security & compliance): Private deployment feasibility review (VPC or on-prem) — legal/ops acceptance testing (KMS/BYOK, audit log export, retention checks).

Milestone gating and acceptance criteria:
- Data residency confirmed (logs + tokens)
- Performance SLOs (p95 token latency) met in target region
- KMS/BYOK capability validated for the chosen lane

Proposed decision date: 2027-03-10 (final recommendation to your execs). If procurement needs it earlier we can compress to 2 weeks and surface the high-risk items.

I'll attach a first-pass MAP document and a lightweight checklist for the POC. Can Marissa loop in pricing so we can show committed tiers for Dedicated vs Private?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna@veridian-health.de>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Thomas Blake <thomas@veridian-health.de>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Veridian MAP kickoff & residency constraints

Anna —

Thanks — looping commercial here. Short answers up front: we can run the Hosted offering from EU zones (Frankfurt/Amsterdam) with our EU data residency controls enabled; Dedicated gives you isolated pools and BYOK integration on request; Private (VPC or on-prem) is scoped for regulated customers and will require a baseline SOW and procurement lead time.

Draft commercial plan (high level):
- Hosted (pilot): low friction, short start (few days), no long-term commitment — ideal for functional validation.
- Dedicated (staging): 30/90 day reserved capacity options for predictable unit economics.
- Private (prod): enterprise contract + deployment window (4–8 weeks typical).

We will produce a pricing grid showing committed GPU-hours and unit prices for Dedicated versus one-off Private deployment costs. I attached the current pricing grid and a version with accelerated procurement discounts. If you can lock the exec decision by Mar 10 we can keep March 25 as the tentative go-live for Hosted + Dedicated staging. If you need Private ready at go-live, that will shift the calendar.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Anna Müller <anna@veridian-health.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Blake <thomas@veridian-health.de>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 08:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Veridian MAP kickoff & residency constraints

Thanks both — this is helpful. A few clarifications before we finalize the MAP:

- Residency: Germany-hosted is preferred (FRA) — is that guaranteed for Hosted or only for Dedicated/Private? Please confirm token and log egress paths.
- KMS/BYOK: procurement requires BYOK or HSM-backed keys for production. Is BYOK available on Dedicated immediately and on Private as a default?
- Audit logs: we need immutable export and 7-year retention. Can Redwood provide an export process we can integrate into our archive?
- Question: If the Hosted trial shows leakage risks for EU-only, will you support a fast fallback to Dedicated in the same region with capacity reservations? We need an escalation path in the MAP.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire (procurement standard). Can we schedule a 60-minute working session next week to walk tech/legal through the checklist? Preferred times: Mon Mar 1 or Tue Mar 2 (CET).

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna@veridian-health.de>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 16:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Veridian MAP kickoff & residency constraints

Anna, Karthik —

Quick legal/ops notes ahead of the working session:

- Data residency guarantee: we can commit to processing and storing customer data exclusively in EU-hosted regions (FRA/AMS) for Hosted and Dedicated when customers opt into the EU residency control plane. We will document network egress paths and logging.
- BYOK/HSM: BYOK is available for Dedicated and Private out of the box. Hosted supports customer-managed keys in our enterprise plan (requires a short SOW).
- Audit logs & retention: we can export immutable event logs to an S3-compatible archive you control; retention policy can be configured to 7 years per your request (need to confirm egress/archival costs).
- Escalation/fallback: we'll include an explicit fallback clause in the MAP that reserves a hot standby Dedicated pool in FRA for 72 hours post-trial in case Hosted reveals non-compliance. That standby will be scoped in the MAP and priced as an optional addendum.

Let's do the working session on Mon, Mar 1 at 14:00 CET. I'll bring the DPA template and a short redline tracker so legal risks are visible during the call.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Legal & Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
